|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[General Grievous (Holo AI) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-generalgrievousholo_ai-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-generalgrievousholo_022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/generalgrievoush.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Dark/large/generalgrievoush.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Raithal Operative”. Text: “Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[General Grievous (Holo AI) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-generalgrievousholo_793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievousholo_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievousholo_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
